title: Hydraulic line pressure drop
line: A steady laminar flow FEA study of hydraulic oil in a 10 mm line at 1 L/min.
description: Steady laminar flow of ISO VG 46 oil at 40 C through a straight 10 mm bore, 300 mm long, at 1 L/min (Re 46). The study returns the pressure drop from inlet to outlet, about 0.83 kPa by Hagen-Poiseuille plus the entrance loss, and the velocity profile along the line.
thumbnailAlt: Oil speed through a 10 mm hydraulic line, solved in RunMat
